sources.excerpt: Published on March 1, 2011 Crossfire distortion overdrive pedal Information The Crossfire Dual-Injection After Burner is a dual-channel drive pedal combining overdrive and distortion circuits in one housing, modeled on the Belcat "The Do" and other Belcat-made dual-drive designs. Each circuit operates independently or in series, offering a flexible range of gain textures from subtle warmth to full, saturated drive. The left channel delivers a distortion voice with a broad gain range and strong midrange focus, while the right channel provides a dynamic overdrive tuned for clarity and touch sensitivity. A toggle switch determines the signal flow, allowing the user to route Overdrive into Distortion for boosted sustain or Distortion into Overdrive for smoother compression and harmonic layering. When both circuits are engaged, the resulting stacked tone produces thick, fuzz-like sustain with responsive dynamics. Built with a solid metal chassis and independent footswitches for each channel, the After Burner maintains the rugged construction typical of Crossfire and Belcat pedals. Both channels feature dedicated Level, Tone, and Gain controls for precise adjustment. The pedal runs on standard 9 VDC center-negative power or a 9V battery. Controls Tone (Distortion / Overdrive): Adjusts the EQ balance from darker to brighter tones. Distortion: Sets the gain level for the distortion channel. Drive: Sets the gain level for the overdrive channel. Level: Controls the output volume of each channel. Select Switch: Determines circuit order: Overdrive→Distortion (down) or Distortion→Overdrive (up). Footswitches: Independent on/off for each channel with status LEDs. Connections Input: 1/4" TS instrument input (acts as power switch when plug is inserted). Output: 1/4" TS output to amplifier or other effects. Power: 9 VDC center-negative (2.5 mm jack) or 9V battery. Technical Specifications Input impedance: 1 MΩ Output impedance: 1 kΩ Power consumption: 10.5 mA Power supply: 9 VDC center negative @ 300 mA Battery: 9V alkaline type 6LR61 Dimensions: 160 x 50 x 112 mm Weight: 442 g Highlights Dual-drive architecture: independent Overdrive and Distortion circuits. Stackable routing with direction toggle for tonal flexibility. Smooth transition from clean boost to high-gain fuzz-like saturation. True bypass switching for transparent signal when off. Rugged metal construction and compact footprint. Directly derived from the Belcat "The Do" and "The Eyes" series, with identical circuit topology and control layout.
